metadata.description: hack-vibe-x skills and hooks for Claude Code. Install only the plugins you want.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-visual-decision
plugins.description: Questions Claude would ask in the terminal are asked in a local web page instead, with a visual for every option and the differences side by side. A hook sends AskUserQuestion to that page while the plugin is on; answers are kept in .hus-visual-decision/decisions in your project. The page runs on 127.0.0.1 and sends nothing elsewhere. Needs Node.js 18 or later; if it is missing, Claude asks before installing anything.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-criteria-gap
plugins.description: When you move on from Claude's answer without having read or understood it, a card above the prompt asks one question that makes you fill the gap: a point you skipped, a premise you missed or took differently. Answers are kept as text to look back on.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-session-coach
plugins.description: Looks back on your AI work sessions: a daily diary written from yesterday's sessions, and a playbook of know-how pulled from sessions you pick. Skills for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-work-plan
plugins.description: Turns a task you were handed, and the material that came with it, into a work plan: what the work is for, how it breaks down, and a path to the end with a prompt and a done check for each step. It asks you every question the material cannot answer, in a web page, and checks every line against the material.
